hack.protocol_name: Aethir (decentralized GPU compute / DePIN; ATH token bridge)
hack.root_cause: Access control — unprotected/misauthorized `transferOwnership()` on AethirOFTAdapter; either missing `onlyOwner` modifier or compromised single-EOA admin key
hack.description: An attacker seized ownership of Aethir's LayerZero OFT bridge adapter on BNB Chain in one `transferOwnership` call, drained ~423,000 ATH (~$400K), and bridged to TRON — but exchange coordination froze most of it, holding net user losses under $90K.
